$comment: Recorded production contract for the Cloudflare Worker configuration (Issue #480). `scripts/check-cloudflare-config-drift.mjs` compares the live `cloudflare.config.ts` surface, the Workers Builds commands, and the static-asset header surface against this file. ONE differing item is ONE finding and ONE red release gate. This file holds NAMES and non-secret identifiers only: a `secret` binding is recorded as `{"type": "secret"}` and a record that carries any other field under it is refused as UNDECIDABLE, so a credential cannot be committed here.
$authority: docs/runbook/cloudflare-config-drift.md (Issue #480). The built artifact side is `scripts/check-cloudflare-contract.mjs --build`; this file is the SOURCE side.

development.$comment: Development must never inherit the production origin (ADR-0014), so the route list is empty here. `LOCAL_API_MODE` is opt-in through `.dev.vars` (Issue #186): its ABSENCE in development is normal, its PRESENCE in production is drift. Any other difference between the two modes is drift too, which is what the gate checks. `mode_only_fields` lists the SCALAR fields (`accountId` / `name` / `compatibilityDate` / `compatibilityFlags` / `entrypoint` / `observability`) that are declared to differ between the two modes; it is empty, so every scalar must be identical in both modes.

build_commands.$comment: The commands Cloudflare Workers Builds runs on a `main` push (docs/runbook/cloudflare-workers-builds.md). No local tool can read that dashboard, so this gate asserts the half the repository owns: the script each command names still exists, and the runbook table still says what this record says.

static_asset_headers.$comment: `public/_headers` is applied by Cloudflare Static Assets and is inert under `vite dev`, so a dropped rule cannot be observed from the development surface. This record pins COVERAGE and the nosniff baseline only; `scripts/check-security-headers.mjs` (Issue #449) owns header values, combination semantics and the Tool grants.
